note: All experimental conditions (dataset, splits, cases, seeds, budget, model, sampling, evaluation) are identical to the SZH 3D baseline protocol; only the method (prompt + system-side stratification/repair) differs.
system: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.

method.name: two-level stratification + forced ground layer + validity repair (3D)

generations.1_verbal: verbal (k2,k3) stratification lines in prompt, no system filter
generations.2_free: no stratification lines + system validity repair (forced Layer 1, subset repair)
generations.4_joint: two-level (k2,k3) stratum + rotating anchor + system repair + reading-order-minimal fallback on parse failure

method.allocation: one query per admissible structure per stratum (stratum size = C(b,k2)*C(k2,k3)); remainder round-robin by decreasing stratum size
method.anchor: feasible (column, in/out of Layer 2, in/out of Layer 3) triples rotate across queries of the same stratum; the anchor is system-enforced by the repair (level-2), with a per-query rotated completion order
method.fallback: parse failure repairs to the reading-order-minimal structure of the assigned stratum
method.a_priori: stratification is fully a-priori; no recovered solution is ever read back, no search, no representation change
